items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I did a little writing for Jimmy Dorsey, too.

ctx.x: That's a big group, and I had to make two arrangements a week. This was in the contract. This was rough, but I never got a chance to go anywhere. (Inaudible). Now I did a little writing for Jimmy Dorsey, too. Now the difference between he and Charley -- and God knows Charley could have stood this better than Jimmy, because Charley's family was wealthy and so was Charlie, you know, and what he cared about a dollar was less. He wasn't cheap at all, but he wanted those two arrangements a week. Jimmy Dorsey was just…
